metadata.title: Grok Imagine Image — Edits Built for Real Work | Oddbeam
metadata.description: Grok Imagine Image (xAI Imagine 2.0) on Oddbeam: point-at-a-region edits, up to 5 reference images in one generation, smart resize across 5 ratios, and typography that plans like a designer. 30 credits per image — text-to-image returns 2 images per run.

hero.title: Grok Imagine Image Generator
hero.description: xAI's Imagine 2.0, built for images you can ship: a wand-style edit changes the region you point at and nothing else, up to 5 reference images combine in a single generation, and smart resize reframes one image across 5 ratios. It ranks second worldwide in both image editing and text-to-image arenas. On Oddbeam it runs at 30 credits per image, and every text-to-image request returns 2 images.
trust_items: Up to 5 reference images in one run

usage.title: The Deliverable-First Workflow
usage.description: Imagine 2.0 treats editing as a first-class capability, so the workflow starts from what you need to ship:

items.title: Start From Text or Up to 5 References
items.description: Write a prompt up to 4,000 characters naming style, lighting, and exact text, or drop up to 5 reference images — subjects combine, styles transfer, and scenes compose without manual compositing.

items.title: Generate Two Takes Per Run
items.description: Every text-to-image request returns 2 images at 30 credits, and image-to-image edits return 1 refined take — compare variations immediately instead of re-rolling one at a time.

items.title: Edit Exactly What You Point At
items.description: Say the change — recolor the jacket, swap the headline, remove the bystander — and the edit applies to the named region while the rest of the frame stays untouched.

items.title: Resize for Every Channel
items.description: Pick 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 16:9, or 9:16 and the model fills the new frame — one master image becomes an Instagram post, a YouTube thumbnail, and a TikTok vertical without re-shooting.

features.title: Precision Editing, Production Ready
features.description: What Imagine 2.0 brings to the Oddbeam workbench:

items.title: Named-region edits
items.description: Magic-wand style editing changes the region you describe and preserves everything else — background removal, object swaps, and color changes export clean, ready to drop into other work.

items.title: Multi-reference composition
items.description: Up to 5 input images in a single generation — combine products, transfer styles, and place characters into new scenes without manual compositing in a separate editor.

items.title: Typography that plans like a designer
items.description: 2.0 plans layout and typography the way a designer would, so dense multi-part visuals hold together and small text stays sharp — posters, labels, and thumbnails come out usable, not almost-usable.

items.title: Consistency across generations
items.description: It preserves what you put in across edits and re-generations — a character, her locations, and her props hold one look from image to image, which is how world-building sets stay coherent.

items.title: Five ratios, one master
items.description: 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 16:9, and 9:16 cover feed posts, prints, YouTube thumbnails, and vertical short-video covers — resize the master instead of re-prompting per channel.

items.question: How much does Grok Imagine Image cost per image?
items.answer: Grok Imagine Image costs 30 credits per generation on Oddbeam. Text-to-image requests return 2 images per run, so the Starter plan's 2,500 monthly credits ($29.99) cover about 83 runs — roughly 166 images — and Pro's 10,000 credits ($89.99) cover about 333 runs.

items.question: What can Grok Imagine Image edit?
items.answer: It handles point-at-a-region edits — recolor an object, swap a headline, remove a bystander — plus segmentation-based selection, background removal to transparent, and style transfer, while leaving everything outside the instruction untouched.

items.question: How many reference images does it accept?
items.answer: Up to 5 reference images in a single generation. Subjects can be combined, styles transferred, and scenes composed in one run — no manual compositing in a separate editor.

items.question: What aspect ratios does it support?
items.answer: Five ratios: 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 16:9, and 9:16. Smart resize fills a new ratio from an existing image, so one master works across feed posts, prints, YouTube thumbnails, and vertical short-video covers.

items.question: Does text-to-image really return two images?
items.answer: Yes. On Oddbeam every Grok Imagine text-to-image request generates 2 images per run at the same 30-credit price, and image-to-image edits return 1 refined image per run.

items.question: Grok Imagine Image or Flux Kontext Max — which should I pick?
items.answer: Pick Grok Imagine Image for multi-reference composition, smart resize across 5 ratios, and 2 takes per run at 30 credits. Pick Flux Kontext Max for one-image iterative editing with character consistency across scenes at 40 credits. Grok builds the asset set; Kontext perfects a single frame.
